name: Free WCAG Fix – A11y Accessibility Enhancer
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
Free WCAG Fix – A11y Accessibility Enhancer is your go-to solution for making WordPress websites accessible and compliant with WCAG 2.2 and ADA standards. This lightweight plugin adds a dynamic accessibility widget with intuitive smart buttons, empowering users to customize their experience instantly. Tap to cycle through options like font size or contrast, or hold for advanced features like dyslexia font or color-blind mode. With multilingual support in 36 languages, it’s built for global reach.

See it in action:
– 52-second demo: Accessibility widget with font, contrast, and language options

Why Choose Free WCAG Fix?
– Smart Buttons: Tap for font size, contrast, spacing, links, motion, or extras. Hold 1.5s for bonuses (e.g., dyslexia font, color-blind mode).
– Click Sounds: New audio feedback (ding for tap, hold for long-press, snap for Joy Burst) with vibration on mobile.
– Multilingual Support: 36 languages with flag dropdown for seamless translation.
– Text-to-Speech: Read selected text aloud for better accessibility.
– WCAG/ADA Compliance: Supports success criteria like 1.4.3 (Contrast), 1.4.4 (Resize Text), 1.4.12 (Text Spacing), 2.3.3 (Animation).
– Lightweight & Fast: Minimal impact on site performance.
– Customizable: Adjust colors, position, and more via admin settings.

How It Works:
1. Install and activate—no setup needed.
2. A sleek widget appears (bottom-right or bottom-left, your choice).
3. Users tap buttons to adjust accessibility or hold for advanced options (vibration feedback on mobile).
4. Settings save via localStorage for a consistent experience.
5. Language selector with flags supports 36 languages.

Perfect For:
– Website owners aiming for WCAG 2.2 and ADA compliance.
– Users with visual impairments, dyslexia, color blindness, or motor challenges.
– Developers seeking a free, user-friendly accessibility solution.

Download now and make your site accessible to everyone!

Demo Video

Explore the plugin’s accessibility features in a 52-second demo, showcasing the widget with font size, contrast, text-to-speech, and 36-language support. Search @pluginjoy-WP on YouTube to find it or DM us for the link.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/a11y-enhancer/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. The accessibility widget appears automatically—customize settings in the admin panel if needed.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin WCAG and ADA compliant?

Yes! The widget is keyboard-navigable, ARIA-compliant, and helps your site meet WCAG 2.2 AA and ADA standards.

How do the smart buttons work?

Tap to cycle through options (e.g., font size levels). Hold for 1.5 seconds to trigger advanced features (e.g., dyslexia font) with visual and vibration feedback.

Can I customize the widget?

Absolutely! Adjust colors, position, font size, and more in the admin settings.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes, it supports 36 languages with a scrollable flag dropdown for easy switching.
sections.changelog:
2.5.2

  • Better language selector and translation strings.
  • Improved button functions for Chrome.
  • Added grey mode function to contrast button.

2.5.1

  • Added click sounds (ding for tap, hold for long-press, snap for Joy Burst) with vibration for enhanced feedback.
  • Updated audio preload and fallback to Web Audio API for better reliability.

2.5.0

  • Added activation tracking to monitor usage (anonymous, GDPR-compliant).
  • Enhanced review prompt with opt-in checkbox for sharing 5-star reviews.
  • Improved widget performance and error logging.

2.0.0

  • Custom language dropdown with flags and scroll.
  • Fixed indicator reset issue.
  • Added powered-by footer.
  • Enhanced hold feedback animation.
  • Optimized readme for WordPress.org.
